one_line: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid personal disclosures, while OpenAI and Amazon advanced AI shopping and payment tools.

themes.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns
themes.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned after admitting to relationships with a subordinate and a Chinese spy, prompting the board to approach Arm CEO Rene Haas as a potential successor. Wall Street and startup investors expressed concern over the leadership change and its impact on Nvidia's aggressive AI dealmaking and startup backing.

themes.title: AI agents move into shopping
themes.text: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet to allow its AI agents to make purchases for U.S. Pro subscribers. Meanwhile, Amazon drafted the World Product Graph to index global product data for AI search and shopping agents.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI agent shopping
Amazon plans World Product Graph to index global product data for AI agents

themes.title: Financial pressures facing AI firms
themes.text: AI cloud provider Nscale reported $5.5 billion in debt and a $1.69 billion loss in an amended IPO filing, while Anthropic excluded mainland China and Hong Kong investors from its IPO due to export rules. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei also highlighted multi-year computing capacity planning as the company's deepest business dilemma.
